import os


def newest_file(folder):
    """Name of the most recently modified file in folder, or None if it has no files."""
    names = os.listdir(folder)
    # Filter out subdirectories and keep only files
    files = [name for name in names if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(folder, name))]
    if not files:
        return None
    return max(files, key=lambda name: os.path.getmtime(os.path.join(folder, name)))
